summary: Q Drives backend fully tested via pytest against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 25 tests passed (100%). Covered health, OTP send/verify (mock 123456), JWT auth + /me + KYC, seeded cars (12) and dealers (5), enriched auctions list/filter/detail with recent_bids, market pulse, dashboard stats, full bidding flow (valid bid, low-amount 400, own-auction 400), outbid notification creation, watchlist toggle, sell flow (POST /cars creates car+auction), AI /price-estimate (first call returned a real Anthropic response; on a re-run the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY hit a 'Budget exceeded' error from LiteLLM and the endpoint correctly fell back to the heuristic — both responses included all required fields and returned 200), and WebSocket /api/ws/auction/{id} snapshot + new_bid broadcast on REST bid.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/dashboard/stats and /api/market/pulse iterate every auction and call _enrich_auction (which does an extra car + seller lookup each). Fine for 12 seeded auctions; will get O(N*2) round-trips at scale — consider $lookup aggregation or caching status counts.

Bid placement is not transactional: insert bid + update auction + create notification + broadcast happen sequentially without a session. A concurrent higher bid arriving between read of current_bid and the update could overwrite — for production add an optimistic guard (update_one with filter current_bid<amount) or a Mongo transaction.
AI price-estimate has no rate limiting / caching; expensive LLM call per request. Heuristic fallback exists which is good.
WebSocket /api/ws/auction/{id} has no auth and no auction-existence check before accept (snapshot is silently skipped if auction missing). Acceptable for read-only feed but worth documenting.

/api/auctions returns up to limit auctions then filters by status in Python — combined with status_filter='live' the limit param can return fewer than expected live auctions. Move status filter into the Mongo query if possible (currently status is computed from times, so OK, but document).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests created TEST_-prefixed transient data: one new dealer per run (random phone +9198XXXXXXXX), one TEST car+auction listing, and a few bids/notifications on existing live auctions. Seed dealers/cars from server.py startup were used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Tests use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env) -> public preview. WebSocket test connects via wss:// to /api/ws/auction/{id}. AI test calls real Anthropic via emergentintegrations and takes ~5s; fallback heuristic also satisfies assertions. Each run creates a fresh dealer (unique phone) and a TEST car listing — DB grows over time; safe to ignore or wipe qdrives_db between iterations.
